# Acme Precision — Company Profile (SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE)

manufacturer headquartered in Suzhou, China.

- Founded: 2008
- Core product line: AC-100 precision pneumatic cylinders
- Working pressure: 5000 PSI
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, CE
- Export markets: Europe, North America, Southeast Asia
